stories.title: Rays capitalize on Guardians' errors to even ALCS at 2-2
stories.summary: The Rays evened their ALCS series against the Guardians at two games apiece with a Game 4 win Saturday night.

stories.title: BYU outlasts Notre Dame, caps upset with stop in end zone
stories.summary: With a defensive stop that concluded in the end zone on the game's final play, No. 8 BYU outlasted No. 2 Notre Dame to preserve a riveting 28-24 victory on Saturday, the Fighting Irish's first loss of the season and a win that moved to Cougars to 6-0.

stories.title: Gabby Williams comes up clutch as Valkyries 'find a way' in Game 1
stories.summary: The Valkyries hold off the Dream 68-64 in Game 1 of the WNBA Finals.

stories.title: Eagles star QB Hurts placed on IR, expected to be out indefinitely
stories.summary: The Eagles have placed Jalen Hurts on injured reserve after consultations with numerous doctors and experts, sources told ESPN and NFL Network.

stories.title: Auburn stuns No. 1 Georgia after Stockton's fumble dooms Bulldogs
stories.summary: Auburn, led by QB Byrum Brown's dominant running game, upset No. 1 Georgia after taking advantage of a key fumble by Gunner Stockton with 58 seconds left.
